comments: Part of the fourth text in [XCKNA9JH]: 392-407. See [DQZ4IIQZ]: 59 (170) and 78-79 (150-151).
alternative_names: snyug bshad gsal byed nor bu (colophon)
name: snyug bshad gsal byed nor bu
item_description:
Colophon, fol. 8ab-b2: snyug bshad gsal byed nor bu 'di || khyung po g.yu khris rjes 'brang nas || legs par 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi 'di | blo ldan shes rab bdag gi sbyar || blo gsal 'gug pa'i rgyan du bkod || 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus
phyag 'tshal || mang-ga lam ||
